Why go: a proper motor yacht for a small group

Elle is a 50 ft motor yacht with two double cabins, each with its own bathroom, an air-conditioned saloon and teak decks with sunbathing space. It cruises at about 15 knots, so an 8-hour charter reaches Ang Thong or Koh Tao with plenty of time at each stop, and the 2-hour sunset cruise along the Samui coast is the shortest way to enjoy it.

With hotel transfer, drinks, snorkel gear and a light lunch on full days, it is a complete luxury day for up to 8 people.

Which charter length

The 2-hour sunset cruise runs along the Samui coast from 16:30 and is the best introduction to the yacht. The 4-hour charters go either to Koh Phangan, for snorkelling at Koh Ma and a beach stop at Haad Rin or Thong Nai Pan, or south to Koh Tan and Pig Island. The 8-hour charters are for Ang Thong, with the Emerald Lake and Koh Wao snorkelling, or Koh Tao and the Koh Nang Yuan viewpoint, both with lunch on board. Air-conditioning and two cabins make the long days comfortable even in the midday heat.

Who it suits

  • Couples and families who want privacy, shade and a bathroom on board.
  • Birthdays, proposals and small celebrations.
  • Groups of 6–8, where the price per head is closest to a premium shared tour.

Who should choose something else

  • Groups on a budget: a private speedboat to Ang Thong or to Pig Island costs a fraction of the price.
  • Sailors: choose a sailing catamaran.
  • Big parties: a junk boat takes up to 40 in comfort.

Good to know

  • Seasons: the high-season rate applies from 1 November to 30 April.
  • Sea conditions: November to January can be choppy on the east side; the captain may switch routes for comfort and safety.
  • Booking: online booking for tomorrow closes at midnight Thai time.
